hook: A midair collision over Washington, D.C. killed 67 people instantly.

sections.voiceover: On January 29, 2025, a UH-60L Black Hawk helicopter collided with a civilian airliner. Why did the International Civil Aviation Organization's three conflict management layers fail during this flight?
sections.visual_cue: Diagram showing a UH-60L Black Hawk flight path intersecting with a commercial airliner.
b_roll: Technical drawing of a UH-60L Black Hawk

sections.voiceover: The International Civil Aviation Organization's airspace, control, and technology layers all failed on January 29, 2025.
sections.visual_cue: Text graphic showing the ICAO logo with an overlay of a broken circuit line.
b_roll: International Civil Aviation Organization official seal

sections.voiceover: LTG Laura Potter led the administrative investigation into these systemic vulnerabilities. These layers failed because Airspace Structure, Air Traffic Control Separation, and Collision Avoidance Technology all exhibited critical vulnerabilities. These gaps directly caused the deaths of 67 people.
sections.visual_cue: Official portrait of LTG Laura Potter beside a summary document icon.

sections.voiceover: Systemic failures claimed 67 lives in Washington, D.C.
